idea-plugin.name: RestfulRadar
idea-plugin.description:
RESTful service navigation for IntelliJ IDEA

Jump from a URL path straight to the controller method that serves it. Paste an address copied from a browser, Postman or a log file, and RestfulRadar scans every REST endpoint in your project and takes you to the matching handler.

Features

  • Search by full URL, relative path or bare endpoint path.
  • Input is normalized automatically: protocol, host, port, query string and hash are stripped.
  • Scans Spring MVC / Spring Boot and JAX-RS endpoints.
  • Works with both Java and Kotlin controllers, including Kotlin K2 mode, without relying on fragile Kotlin internal indexes.
  • Filter results by HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, ...).
  • Optionally limit the search to the current module.
  • Reuses the text selected in the editor or the URL in the clipboard as the initial query.
  • Choose a modal dialog or a right-side tool window as the default search UI.
  • Optional Windows acceleration with Everything (es.exe): project files are enumerated through Everything, and a rescan re-parses only the files changed since the previous scan (dm: query). When es.exe is not configured or cannot be detected, the plugin automatically falls back to the IDE index and behaves exactly as before.

How to use

  1. Press Ctrl+Alt+/, or run Go to REST Service from Find Action.
  2. Paste or type the request address, for example /api/users/42 or https://example.com/api/users/42?active=true.
  3. Optionally pick an HTTP method and tick Current module.
  4. Press Enter or click a result to open the matching controller method.

Path variables are supported, for example /users/{id} or /orders/{orderId:\d+}.

Actions and shortcuts

  • Go to REST Service - Ctrl+Alt+/, opens the search UI configured in the settings.
  • Switch REST Search UI - Ctrl+Alt+Shift+/, toggles the preferred search UI.
  • Go to REST Service (Dialog) and Go to REST Service (Popup) - always open the fixed UI; no default shortcut, bind your own under Settings | Keymap.
  • Rescan REST Mappings - clear the cache and scan the project again.
  • All actions are also available under Tools | RestfulRadar.

Settings

Under Settings | Tools | RestfulRadar you can choose the window opened by Ctrl+Alt+/ (dialog or right-side tool window), the maximum number of results shown in the list, and the path to es.exe. Leave the es.exe path empty to auto-detect it (from PATH or the default Everything installation directory). Everything is optional: without it the plugin still works, scans just take longer.

Compatibility

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3 (build 243) and later, up to 2026.3.
  • Uses the bundled Java, Kotlin, YAML and Properties plugins.
  • No runtime dependency on Spring or JAX-RS libraries.
  • Everything (es.exe) acceleration is available on Windows only; other platforms use the IDE index automatically.

License

Apache License 2.0. Source code and issue tracker: github.com/XiShanRain/RestfulRadar

RestfulRadar 使用说明（中文）

把从浏览器、Postman 或日志中复制的请求地址粘贴进来，RestfulRadar 会扫描项目中的全部 REST 接口，直接跳转到对应的控制器方法。

功能特性

  • 支持完整 URL、相对路径以及纯接口路径搜索。
  • 输入自动规范化：自动去掉协议、域名、端口、查询参数和 hash 片段。
  • 支持 Spring MVC / Spring Boot 与 JAX-RS 接口扫描。
  • 同时支持 Java 与 Kotlin 控制器，兼容 Kotlin K2 模式，不依赖脆弱的 Kotlin 内部索引。
  • 支持按 HTTP Method（GET、POST、PUT、DELETE、PATCH 等）过滤结果。
  • 支持只搜索当前模块。
  • 优先复用编辑器中选中的文本或剪贴板中的 URL 作为初始搜索内容。
  • 可选模态对话框或右侧工具窗口作为默认搜索界面。
  • 可选 Windows 加速：配置 Everything 命令行 es.exe 后，插件借助 Everything 枚举项目文件， 并可按修改时间（dm: 查询）只重新解析上次扫描后发生变化的文件，大幅缩短增量刷新耗时； 未配置或检测不到 es.exe 时自动回退到 IDEA 索引，功能不受影响。

使用步骤

  1. 按 Ctrl+Alt+/，或在 Find Action 中执行 Go to REST Service。
  2. 粘贴或输入请求地址，例如 /api/users/42 或 https://example.com/api/users/42?active=true。
  3. 按需选择 HTTP Method，并勾选 Current module 限定搜索范围。
  4. 按 Enter 或点击结果，跳转到对应的控制器方法。

支持路径变量，例如 /users/{id} 或 /orders/{orderId:\d+}。

动作与快捷键

  • Go to REST Service - Ctrl+Alt+/，按设置中配置的界面打开搜索。
  • Switch REST Search UI - Ctrl+Alt+Shift+/，切换首选搜索界面。
  • Go to REST Service (Dialog) 与 Go to REST Service (Popup) - 始终打开固定界面， 未设默认快捷键，可在 Settings | Keymap 中自行绑定。
  • Rescan REST Mappings - 清除缓存并重新扫描项目。
  • 所有动作也可从 Tools | RestfulRadar 菜单触发。

设置

在 Settings | Tools | RestfulRadar 中可选择 Ctrl+Alt+/ 打开的窗口（对话框或右侧工具窗口）、 结果列表的最大显示条数，以及 es.exe 路径。es.exe 路径留空时会自动检测（PATH 与 Everything 默认安装目录）；未安装 Everything 时插件照常工作，仅扫描耗时略长。

兼容性

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3（build 243）及以上，最高支持到 2026.3。
  • 依赖内置的 Java、Kotlin、YAML 与 Properties 插件。
  • 不依赖 Spring 或 JAX-RS 运行库。
  • Everything（es.exe）加速仅在 Windows 上生效，其它平台自动使用 IDEA 索引。
